alternatives.reason: Checking partners would be safer, but variation has already produced a lineage in this chapter.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making limbed vertebrates from fish and roots was most worthwhile: the waterside habitat made the transition tangible, while the explanation distinguished evolution across generations from an animal choosing to grow limbs.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the shelled egg felt mostly like following the only available route; it clarified the next step but offered little decision-making.

surprise.text: Fallen wood led directly to small mammals from limbed vertebrates, showing a separate branch rather than requiring the reptile route.

arbitrary.text: Reptiles plus air producing birds felt compressed as a recipe, although the result explained the dinosaur lineage and the independent evolution of bird and insect flight.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the animals’ effects on their forest and the hint of a future impact make me curious about what happens to the world next.
